Optionally owns driver, display / speaker / camera / mic
ruff bans direct imports of io/
Owned by Palmimo; opened/closed via connect() / disconnect()
Layer 2 · palmimo_sdk.io — I/O boundary (resource layer, internal)
Black ↓ = commands out (servo / face / speech) · Blue ↑ = data in (video / audio) · Different directions, both owned by Palmimo
